1.title: A Bay Area Pastor Made an A.I. Twin to Talk About God at Any Time
1.summary: To meet the growing needs of his church, Justin Lester created an A.I. duplicate of himself. Every day he sees more people using it.

2.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
2.summary: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

3.title: Fauci on 'solid legal ground' in face of prosecution threat, lawyer says
3.summary: The US medical expert faces possible contempt-of-Congress proceedings for refusing to answer questions during a hearing on Covid.

4.title: Poland’s Leader Says Russian Missile May Have Struck Its Territory During Ukraine Attack
4.summary: Russian missiles have briefly entered Polish airspace in the past. Investigators have yet to definitively identify the object that struck Poland overnight.

5.summary: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

6.title: Russia Strikes Ukraine With Missiles and Drones, Killing at Least 8
6.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine said that a family of five had been killed at home in the latest in a series of large-scale aerial assaults by Moscow.
